name: boundary
facts: The scan sends DNS queries, HTTP GET and HEAD with a realistic User-Agent, and TLS handshakes
It GETs a fixed list of known-sensitive paths against the target's own vhost
It performs TCP connect and banner reads on a shared IP
It never sends credentials, payloads, injection, traversal, uploads or directory brute-forcing
It never probes other tenants on shared infrastructure
Coverage gaps are deliberate and named in the report methodology
